name: Loot Line - Season 2
source:
Loot Line - Season 2 is a pirate-themed AVN adventure that continues a journey from Season 1 through a vibrant fantasy world.

This isn't just a simple treasure hunt, you'll explore stunning landscapes, encounter a diverse crew of characters, and get to experience a world filled with unique kinks and niches.

Your journey is more than just about survival and treasure. Every decision you make defines your path:

Will you be a true leader who earns the respect of your crew, or a reckless captain who stumbles through chaos?
Will you uncover the hidden truths of your past, or let them sink beneath the waves forever?

Season 2 continues the saga with expanded storylines, new characters, deeper relationships, and tougher choices that shape not only your fate, but the destiny of everyone aboard. Explore a world where lust, loyalty, betrayal, and adventure collide on the high seas — and where the line between hero and villain is as thin as the horizon.

[From [url=https://www.gog.com/en/game/loot_line_season_2]GoG[/url]]
translation:
Loot Line - 第2季是一款以海盗为主题的AVN冒险游戏，延续第1季的旅程，穿越充满活力的奇幻世界。

这不仅仅是一次简单的寻宝活动，你将探索令人惊叹的风景，遇到各种各样的角色，并体验一个充满独特怪癖和利基的世界。

你的旅程不仅仅是关于生存和宝藏。你做出的每一个决定都决定了你的道路：

你会成为一位赢得船员尊重的真正领导者，还是一位在混乱中跌跌撞撞的鲁莽船长？
你会揭开过去隐藏的真相，还是让它们永远沉入海底？

第二季延续了这个传奇故事，增加了更多的故事情节、新的角色、更深层次的关系和更艰难的选择，这些选择不仅决定了你的命运，也决定了船上每个人的命运。探索一个欲望、忠诚、背叛和冒险在公海上碰撞的世界，英雄和恶棍之间的界限就像地平线一样薄弱。

[来自[url=https://www.gog.com/en/game/loot_line_season_2]GoG[/url]]
